outline.chapter_title: Foundations of Attention and GPU Computing
outline.description: Introduce the Transformer attention mechanism and the GPU execution model that underlies modern deep‑learning workloads. This chapter sets the conceptual background, aligning the mathematical notation used in FlashAttention‑3 with the hardware intricacies that the new algorithm exploits.

outline.description: Review the evolution of GPU‑aware attention implementations, culminating in the design decisions of FlashAttention‑2 that motivate the need for FlashAttention‑3.
